subject: How to search and replace _specific_ characters in string

messages.author: 20a4c389c493c963
messages.subject: How to search and replace _specific_ characters in string
parts:
I have a column in a data.frame  (~22k rows) like this:

HR_size$ind

[1]   x12288.14.12.2014
[2]   x12288.15.12.2014
[3]   x12288.16.12.2014
[4]   x12288.17.12.2014
[5]   x12288.18.12.2014
[6]   x6815.17.12.2014
[7]   x6815.18.12.2014
[8]   x6815.17.12.2014
[9]   x6815.21.3.2014
[10] x6815.9.4.2015

The data frame is returned by a different function,  and I can't control its initial layout.
My problem is that the x# (e.g., x12288, x6815) are names of individuals and should be followed by a space (" "), and the the dd.mm.yyyy should be dd/mm/yyyy, resulting in:

[1]   x12288 14/12/2014
...
[10] x6815 9/4/2015

I've tried using gsub() and {stringi} to no avail because the names of inds. aren't the same length and I can't simply replace all "." with " " or "/".

Any ideas please?

Much obliged,
Renanel

messages.author: 1914bd286a0c74d3
messages.subject: Re: How to search and replace _specific_ characters in string
parts:
the following code should work. You need to  install the package stringr


data<-c("x12288.14.12.2014",

"x12288.15.12.2014"
   ,"x12288.16.12.2014"
  ,"x12288.17.12.2014"
  ,"x12288.18.12.2014"
  ,"x6815.17.12.2014"
  ,"x6815.18.12.2014"
  ,"x6815.17.12.2014"
   ,"x6815.21.3.2014"
 ,"x6815.9.4.2015")

library(stringr)
   
   #find the locations of the dots in the string
   dotLocations<-str_locate_all(pattern ="\\.",data)
   
   #create a vector of the locations of the first dots
   firstLocations<-sapply(1:length(data),function(x){dotLocations[[x]][1]})
   
   #sub the first dot character in the data with space according to the locations in the firstLocations vector
   transformedData<-sapply(1:length(data),function(x){`str_sub<-`(data[x],firstLocations[x],firstLocations[x]," ")})
   
   #replace the other dots with slash
   transformedData<-gsub("\\.","/",transformedData)
